# A capturing nested component instantiated in a reactive `for` is reported
# rather than emitted (#202).
#
# The boundary is what the inliner already computes. A *non*-capturing nested
# component in the same position survives as a real component whose state the
# render owns -- `var picked by remember` inside the Compose function, per row.
# A capturing one cannot survive that way, because its body reads a var only
# the owner's instance has, so splicing it hands every row the one cell: it
# builds and then behaves wrong. A reactive `if` is the same shape, with the
# state outliving the unmount instead of being fresh per mount.
#
# (bubbletea hoists a surviving component's var to a Model field, so it shares
# one cell there too -- its own defect in the RuntimeInstance path, and not a
# reason to let capture in.)
#
# A *non-reactive* loop is deliberately not an error: a nested component there
# shares one cell with or without capture, which is the pre-existing
# rc.repeated limitation and not this change's to widen.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out reactive.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a reactive if or for'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out2 reactive_if.sngl
stderr 'reads the state of the body it is declared in and is instantiated inside a reactive if or for'

# Same program with the capture removed: allowed, and `row` survives as a
# component of its own rather than being spliced.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out3 nocapture.sngl
grep 'func \(m Model\) renderRow' out3/model.go

# Capture under a loop that depends on nothing reactive stays allowed.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out4 static.sngl

-- reactive.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0
    var items = [1, 2, 3]

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    button(text="grow", @click { items = [1, 2, 3, 4] })

    for var i = items {
        row(n=i)
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- reactive_if.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0
    var shown = false

    component panel() node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    button(text="toggle", @click { shown = !shown })

    if shown {
        panel()
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- nocapture.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component outer() node {
    var items = [1, 2, 3]

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click { picked = !picked })
    }

    button(text="grow", @click { items = [1, 2, 3, 4] })

    for var i = items {
        row(n=i)
    }
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- static.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component outer() node {
    var count = 0

    component row(n = 0) node {
        var picked = false

        button(text="{n} {picked}", @click {
            picked = !picked
            count = count + 1
        })
    }

    for var i = [1, 2, 3] {
        row(n=i)
    }

    text(value="{count}")
}

component main node {
    outer()
}

app.window {
    main
}
